description: KNaReH₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. K is bonded in a 14-coordinate geometry to fourteen H atoms. There are a spread of K-H bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.93 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.44 Å. Re is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine H atoms. There are a spread of Re-H bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.70 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent K and one Re atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Re atom. In the third H site, H is bonded to one K, two equivalent Na, and one Re atom to form distorted HKNa₂Re tetrahedra that share corners with ten HKNa₂Re tetrahedra and edges with four HK₂NaRe tetrahedra. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two equivalent K and one Re atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Re atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Re atom to form distorted HK₂NaRe tetrahedra that share corners with ten HKNa₂Re tetrahedra and edges with four HK₂NaRe tetrahedra.
